title: THE EFFECT OF USING A MOODLE-BASED LEARNING MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (LMS) ON MOTIVATION AND LEARNING OUTCOMES OF NURSING STUDENTS
reason: Article body is in Indonesian (only the second abstract is English). Secondarily, the only relation reported links self-reported MSLQ motivation to an LMS-delivered test score; no platform activity indicator is analysed.

extraction.n_quote: The sample consisted of 34 second-semester students in the D3 Nursing program.
extraction.lms_indicators: none per student (test administered in Moodle)
extraction.notes: Secondary code NOREL: R=0.68 (R2=0.46) is MSLQ motivation vs test score, both non-log measures.
